<!doctype html>

<html lang="bn">

<head>

<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#f2f8ed">

<title>Muslims Day · Lifetime Membership</title>

<style>

@font-face{font-family:'MD Bengali';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype')}

@font-face{font-family:'MD Bengali';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype')}

:root{--forest:#005c36;--green:#087442;--lime:#8dc63f;--ink:#123b28;--muted:#45614f;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}

*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f2f8ed;color:var(--ink);font-family:'MD Bengali',system-ui,sans-serif}button,a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button{font:inherit}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #558622;outline-offset:4px}

.page{min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#d9ecd0,transparent 65%),#f4f9f0}.page img{width:72px;height:72px}.page h1{font-size:25px}.reopen{padding:14px 24px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--forest);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}

dialog{width:100%;height:100%;height:100dvh;max-width:none;max-height:none;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;overflow:hidden;background:#f4f9f0;color:var(--ink)}dialog[open]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}dialog::backdrop{background:#092d1bd6;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}body:has(dialog[open]){overflow:hidden}

.ambience{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 47% at 50% 0%,#e3f0d2,transparent 95%),linear-gradient(150deg,#f7faee,#f2f8ef 55%,#edf6ee)}.halo{position:absolute;left:calc(50% - 160px);top:-50px;width:320px;height:320px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#afdb674a,transparent 70%);animation:aurora 8s ease-in-out infinite}.halo.bottom{left:auto;right:-120px;top:auto;bottom:-80px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#45996522,transparent 70%);animation-delay:-4s}.grid{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(#406e2d29 .6px,transparent .6px);background-size:9px 9px;opacity:.23;mask-image:linear-gradient(#000,transparent 75%)}

.topbar{z-index:2;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 22px 4px}.brand{font:700 15px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:var(--forest);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.brand img{width:24px;height:24px;object-fit:contain}.close{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:#819780;transition:color .2s,background .2s}.close:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-5px;border-radius:50%}.close:hover{color:#476b50;background:#ffffff55}.close svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:1.4}

.content{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(100%,490px);min-height:0;flex:1;margin:0 auto;padding:7px 23px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:0}

.hero-mark{position:relative;flex-shrink:0;width:116px;height:112px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 0 12px}.logo-wrap{position:relative;width:82px;height:82px;animation:logo-float 6s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 15px #27643126)}.hero-logo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}.orbit{position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid #54844522;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(-20deg)}.orbit::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:12px;top:15px;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--lime);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 12px #8dc63f66}.orbit.outer{inset:-8px;border-style:dashed;border-color:#54844518;animation:spin 36s linear infinite}.mini-infinity{position:absolute;bottom:0;right:-7px;width:35px;height:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid #f5f9ee;border-radius:11px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#e6f0b6,#c8e477);color:#225b25;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #365e2222}.mini-infinity svg{width:23px;height:16px}.star{position:absolute;font:23px system-ui;color:#79a435;right:-3px;top:3px;animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite}.star.small{font-size:13px;left:-6px;right:auto;top:auto;bottom:10px;animation-delay:-2s}

.eyebrow{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2.2px;color:#5b7548;margin:0 0 14px}.eyebrow:before,.eyebrow:after{content:'';width:19px;height:1px;background:#b4c99a}

h1{flex-shrink:0;margin:0 0 17px;font-size:clamp(27px,6.6vw,33px);line-height:1.43;letter-spacing:-.65px;font-weight:700}#offer-title:focus{outline:none}

.intro{display:block;font-size:.74em;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin-bottom:6px;animation:reveal .8s var(--ease) .1s both}.hero-line{display:block;animation:reveal .9s var(--ease) .23s both}.hero-line:last-child{animation-delay:.4s}.forever{position:relative;display:inline-block;color:var(--forest);background:linear-gradient(105deg,#005b34 15%,#258545 35%,#739e22 50%,#087443 65%,#005b34 85%);background-size:250% 100%;background-clip:text;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:word-light 5s ease-in-out 1s infinite}.forever:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:3px;height:5px;border-radius:100%;background:#a6cf5260;z-index:-1;transform-origin:left;animation:underline-in 1s var(--ease) .8s both}

.invitation{flex-shrink:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px;max-width:330px;animation:reveal .8s var(--ease) .5s both}.limited{position:relative;display:inline-block;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;color:#285713;font-size:1.23em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:nowrap;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#e3efbf,#edf6d3);border:1px solid #c8dda2;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #8dc63f00;border-radius:7px;padding:2px 7px;animation:limited-pulse 2.8s ease-in-out 1.2s infinite}.limited:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 15%,#ffffffa3 48%,transparent 80%);transform:translateX(-150%);animation:limited-shine 4s ease-in-out 1.6s infinite}

.benefits{flex-shrink:0;width:100%;list-style:none;padding:5px 15px;margin:0;text-align:left;border-radius:17px;background:#ffffffe0;border:1px solid #dbe8d2;box-shadow:0 9px 25px -19px #2c64283b;animation:reveal .8s var(--ease) .6s both}.benefits li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:500}.benefits li+li{border-top:1px solid #e8eee2}.check{width:23px;height:23px;flex-shrink:0;background:#eaf4dc;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#387320}.check svg{width:13px;height:13px}.benefits strong{font-weight:700}.benefits li:nth-child(1) .check{animation:check-pop .55s var(--ease) .9s both}.benefits li:nth-child(2) .check{animation:check-pop .55s var(--ease) 1.05s both}.benefits li:nth-child(3) .check{animation:check-pop .55s var(--ease) 1.2s both}

.payment{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:700;color:#527046;margin:17px 0 0;animation:reveal .8s var(--ease) .75s both}.payment svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:#6f8c5e}

.footer{position:relative;z-index:3;flex-shrink:0;width:min(100%,490px);margin:0 auto;padding:8px 23px calc(23px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.cta{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:58px;line-height:1.7;padding:13px 12px;color:white;text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#005b34,#087442 60%,#258b40);border:1px solid #ffffff40;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #12692b38,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff30;isolation:isolate;animation:reveal .9s var(--ease) .9s both,cta-breathe 3.5s ease-in-out 2s infinite;transition:transform .2s,filter .2s}.cta:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-5px;border:1px solid #8dc63f88;border-radius:21px;opacity:0;z-index:-1;animation:cta-ring 3.5s ease-out 2s infinite;pointer-events:none}.cta-light{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}.cta-light:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 25%,#efffce35 48%,transparent 65%);transform:translateX(-140%);animation:sweep 5s ease-in-out 1.5s infinite}.arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:27px;height:27px;background:#ffffff14;border:1px solid #ffffff24;border-radius:50%;animation:arrow-nudge 2.5s ease-in-out 2s infinite}.arrow svg{width:16px;height:16px}.cta:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}.cta:active{transform:scale(.985)}

@keyframes limited-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #8dc63f00}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #8dc63f20,0 2px 12px #84b63820}}@keyframes limited-shine{0%,40%{transform:translateX(-150%)}75%,100%{transform:translateX(150%)}}

@keyframes reveal{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);filter:blur(0)}}@keyframes logo-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(2deg)}}@keyframes aurora{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:translate(15px,12px) scale(1.12)}}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(340deg)}}@keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.3;transform:scale(.8)}50%{opacity:.9;transform:scale(1.1)}}@keyframes word-light{0%,100%{background-position:100% 50%}50%{background-position:0 50%}}@keyframes underline-in{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}@keyframes check-pop{from{transform:scale(.3);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}@keyframes cta-breathe{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 8px 22px #12692b38,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff30}50%{box-shadow:0 8px 28px #12692b50,0 0 0 3px #8dc63f20,inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff30}}@keyframes cta-ring{0%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(1)}65%,100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.035,1.15)}}@keyframes sweep{0%,40%{transform:translateX(-140%)}78%,100%{transform:translateX(140%)}}@keyframes arrow-nudge{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(3px)}}

@media(min-width:700px){dialog{width:480px;height:min(740px,calc(100dvh - 32px));margin:auto;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 25px 90px #002b1a55}.topbar{padding-top:13px}h1{font-size:32px}.content{padding-left:28px;padding-right:28px}.footer{padding-left:28px;padding-right:28px}.benefits li{font-size:14px}}

@media(max-height:740px){.hero-mark{width:94px;height:88px;margin-bottom:9px}.logo-wrap{width:66px;height:66px}.mini-infinity{width:30px;height:25px;right:-4px}.eyebrow{margin-bottom:10px;font-size:9px}h1{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:12px}.intro{margin-bottom:4px}.invitation{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:13px;line-height:1.75}.benefits li{padding:10px 0}.payment{margin-top:12px}.footer{padding-bottom:15px}.cta{min-height:54px}}

@media(max-height:650px){.topbar{padding-top:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top));padding-bottom:0}.close{width:34px;height:34px}.content{padding-top:5px;padding-bottom:5px}.hero-mark{width:76px;height:70px;margin-bottom:7px}.logo-wrap{width:52px;height:52px}.mini-infinity{width:26px;height:23px;border-radius:8px}.mini-infinity svg{width:18px;height:13px}.eyebrow{margin-bottom:8px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.8px}h1{font-size:25px;line-height:1.37;margin-bottom:10px}.intro{font-size:.74em;margin-bottom:4px}.invitation{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:10px}.benefits{padding:3px 11px;border-radius:14px}.benefits li{padding:8px 0;font-size:12px;gap:9px;line-height:1.6}.check{width:21px;height:21px}.payment{font-size:11px;margin-top:10px}.footer{padding-top:5px;padding-bottom:calc(13px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.cta{min-height:50px;padding:11px 10px;font-size:14px;border-radius:14px}.cta:before{border-radius:19px}}

@media(max-width:360px){.content{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}.topbar{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}.footer{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}.benefits li{font-size:12px}h1{font-size:25px}}

@media(max-height:520px){.hero-mark{display:none}.eyebrow{margin-bottom:8px}.content{justify-content:center}h1{font-size:23px;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px}.invitation{margin-bottom:8px}.benefits li{padding:6px 0}.payment{margin-top:7px}.footer{padding-bottom:10px}.cta{min-height:46px;padding:8px 10px}}

@media(max-height:420px) and (orientation:landscape){dialog[open]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:42px 1fr 65px}.topbar{grid-column:1 / -1;max-width:none;padding:4px 20px}.content{display:contents}.hero-mark,.eyebrow{display:none}h1{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;margin:auto 12px;align-self:center}.invitation{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;margin:auto 15px;font-size:11px}.benefits{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;align-self:center;width:calc(100% - 28px);margin:0 14px}.payment{display:none}.footer{grid-column:2;grid-row:3;align-self:center;padding:5px 14px;margin:0}.cta{font-size:12px;min-height:46px}.arrow{width:22px;height:22px}}

@media(max-height:650px){.hero-mark{height:64px;margin-bottom:5px}.eyebrow{margin-bottom:6px}h1{margin-bottom:8px}.invitation{margin-bottom:8px}.payment{margin-top:8px}}

@media(max-height:420px) and (orientation:landscape){.invitation{line-height:1.5;margin:auto 15px}.limited{font-size:1.12em;line-height:1.2;padding:0 3px;border:0}}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;filter:none!important}.forever{background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--forest)}}

</style>

</head>

<body>

<main class="page"><div><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Muslims Day"><h1>Muslims Day</h1><button class="reopen" id="reopen" type="button">পপআপ আবার দেখুন</button></div></main>

<dialog id="lifetime-popup" aria-labelledby="offer-title" aria-describedby="offer-description">

<div class="ambience" aria-hidden="true"><div class="halo"></div><div class="halo bottom"></div><div class="grid"></div></div>

<header class="topbar"><div class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">Muslims Day</div><button class="close" id="close-popup" type="button" aria-label="পপআপ বন্ধ করুন"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button></header>

<div class="content">

<div class="hero-mark" aria-hidden="true"><div class="orbit"></div><div class="orbit outer"></div><span class="star">✦</span><span class="star small">✦</span><div class="logo-wrap"><img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><span class="mini-infinity"><svg viewBox="0 0 100 54" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M50 27C36 6 27 7 20 7 1 7 1 47 20 47c14 0 21-20 30-20S64 7 80 7c19 0 19 40 0 40-14 0-22-20-30-20Z"/></svg></span></div></div>

<div class="eyebrow" lang="en">LIFETIME MEMBERSHIP</div>

<h1 id="offer-title" tabindex="-1" autofocus><span class="intro">আপনার প্রিয় মুসলিমস ডে</span><span class="hero-line">এবার হোক <span class="forever">আজীবনের</span></span><span class="hero-line">ইবাদতের সঙ্গী।</span></h1>

<p class="invitation" id="offer-description">এই অক্টোবরে <strong class="limited">মাত্র ৩০ জনকে</strong> বিশেষ লাইফটাইম মেম্বারশিপের সুযোগ দিচ্ছে মুসলিমস ডে।</p>

<ul class="benefits">

<li><span class="check" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="m4 10 4 4 8-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span><span>আজীবন <strong lang="en">Muslims Day Premium</strong></span></li>

<li><span class="check" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="m4 10 4 4 8-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span><span>মাসিক বা বার্ষিক রিনিউয়ালের প্রয়োজন নেই</span></li>

<li><span class="check" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none"><path d="m4 10 4 4 8-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span><span>বিশেষ <strong lang="en">Lifetime</strong> মেম্বারশিপ ব্যাজ</span></li>

</ul>

<p class="payment"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3 8 3v6c0 5-8 9-8 9s-8-4-8-9V6l8-3Z"/><path d="m8 12 3 3 5-6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>একবার পেমেন্ট। আজীবন প্রিমিয়াম।</p>

</div>

<footer class="footer"><a class="cta" id="lifetime-cta" href="https://id.kahf.co/pay/muslimsday-lifetime"><span class="cta-light" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>আমি লাইফটাইম মেম্বার হতে চাই</span><span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></span></a></footer>

</dialog>

<script>

/* App integration: MuslimsDayLifetime.open(), close(), setCheckoutUrl(url).

Events: md-lifetime-open, md-lifetime-close, md-lifetime-cta.

Schedule the October campaign and validate the 30-member cap in the app.

No fabricated live counter or countdown is used. */

(()=>{

const dialog=document.getElementById('lifetime-popup'),cta=document.getElementById('lifetime-cta');let restoreFocus=null;

const emit=(name,detail={})=>window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name,{detail}));

function open(){if(dialog.open)return;restoreFocus=document.activeElement;dialog.showModal();emit('md-lifetime-open');}

function close(reason='api'){if(dialog.open)dialog.close(reason);}

document.getElementById('close-popup').addEventListener('click',()=>close('close-button'));

document.getElementById('reopen').addEventListener('click',open);

dialog.addEventListener('cancel',e=>{e.preventDefault();close('escape');});

dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{emit('md-lifetime-close',{reason:dialog.returnValue});if(restoreFocus?.isConnected)restoreFocus.focus();});

cta.addEventListener('click',()=>emit('md-lifetime-cta',{url:cta.href}));

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{dialog.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(el=>el.style.animationPlayState=document.hidden?'paused':'running');});

window.MuslimsDayLifetime={open,close,setCheckoutUrl(url){const parsed=new URL(url,location.href);if(!['https:','http:'].includes(parsed.protocol))throw Error('Checkout URL must use HTTP(S)');cta.href=parsed.href;}};

open();

})();

</script>

</body>

</html>
